result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: on expiry or termination, Vendor must provide requested transition assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return Customer Data in a documented machine-readable format within 30 days of request, and securely delete and certify deletion thereafter. The revision appropriately replaces only the conflicting immediate-cessation provision while preserving the existing export, metadata, fee-dispute, retention, and security terms. It is clear and professionally drafted.
